maya (Finance): payments-bot flagged INV-9832 (Arvo Health) — card declined FRAUD_SUSPECTED after 3 attempts. Customer says card is on bank hold and needs payment posted today to avoid service pause. Can we provide wire details + expedited approval? Amount: $27,450.00.

payments-bot: charge_attempt failed: status=declined code=FRAUD_SUSPECTED txn=ch_3J9a2X; attempts=3; last_attempt=2267001100

nora (Acct Manager): i've asked AR to ask customer for alternate card, they're stuck on bank hold. they prefer wire. have they completed KYC? we have contract and PO.

ajay (Finance Ops): i can do manual wire but need 2 approvals for >$25k. also need copy of invoice, PO, and beneficiary name matching bank. send me the customer's wiring instructions (pdf or screenshot).

lloyd (Payments Eng): quick check — routing vs our bank: if destination requires ben name normalization, we need full legal name + tax id. Also confirm whether we should mark as 'non-refundable' in SAP.

maya (Finance): attaching snippets (copied below). PO# ARVO-2026-78; invoice INV-9832; amount $27,450. Customer wiring details provided by client: Beneficiary: Arvo Health Inc.; Bank: First National Bank; ABA: 111000025; Account: 987654321; SWIFT: FNBAUS33. They've also sent a KYC PDF (checked).

maya (Finance): copy/paste of bank details in case attachments blocked: 
```
Beneficiary: Arvo Health Inc.
Account: 987654321
Routing (ABA): 111000025
SWIFT: FNBAUS33
Reference: INV-9832 / PO ARVO-2026-78
Amount: USD 27,450.00
```

grace (CFO): @ajay approved for urgent wire up to $35k. :white_check_mark: Mark as 'customer requested expedited wire due to card hold'.

ajay (Finance Ops): got approval. I'm initiating the wire with bank. Sending manual wire form now to treasury. Expected settlement 2-4 business hours; will update when completed. Will also record trace id once bank confirms.

lloyd (Payments Eng): FYI — flag in ledger to avoid automated retry on card after wire clears. add note to ticket: payment method switched to wire at customer's request.

nora (Acct Manager): i'll confirm with customer once we have confirmation. Thanks team! :pray:
